messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: paged-kv pool 'us-east-1' memory growth > 85% for 12m, eviction-rate spiking, continuous-batching latency cliff detected. Auto-created thread in #eng-oncall.

Sanjay: seeing huge KV metadata reads and blockmgr churn. paging_iops up 4x. this started ~11:10 UTC.

Marta: yup, dashboards show continuous_batching_requests jumping 3x after the rollout at 10:55. suspect batching logic regression + larger block sizes interacting badly with eviction policy.

Raj: tagging @Marta @Sanjay - do we have a quick mitigation we can push? customers already seeing 5xx?

CS-Bot: Customer ticket #7892 (Acme) reporting generation timeouts ~11:25 UTC, retry storms. Dedicated customers in us-east impacted.

Jeff: timeline: we rolled batch-optimizer v2.3.1 at 10:55 which changed the batch coalescing threshold and prefetched more KV blocks into memory. Looks like prefetch pattern + blocksize=4MB caused metadata to balloon.

Marta: immediate plan: 1) disable continuous_batching on prod routing via feature flag 2) reduce batch_coalesce_threshold to previous value 3) shrink block_size to 2MB for paged-kv buckets.

Sanjay: agree. I'll flip the flag and patch runtime config. doing step 1 now.

Sanjay: (command)
```
# disable continuous batching via control plane
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/flags/continuous_batching -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

Sanjay: flag flipped. monitoring evictions and tail latency.

Marta: good. I'm preparing a hotfix for the batch-optimizer rollback (revert commit fc3a9b) and a smaller blocksize config. prepping canary patch.

Raj: I'll open a mitigation runbook entry and notify oncall pager.

Lina: FYI core dump collector has a couple of paged-kv OOM traces, attaching excerpts.

Lina: (log snippet)
```
[11:22:18] paged_kv: evict_async failed, metadata_entries=1248912, alloc=3.9GB
[11:22:20] blockmgr: pinned_block_count=2146, pending_prefetch=482
```

Jeff: metrics: mem.allocated by paged-kv went from 1.8GB -> 6.1GB in 15m. eviction throughput couldn't keep up because batch sizes kept prefetching big blocks.

Marta: can we hotpatch block_size at runtime? I can push a per-pool config that sets block_size=2MB for the affected pool.

Sanjay: applying pool-level override now (rolling).

Sanjay: (command)
```
rbctl pools update us-east-1-paged-kv --set block_size=2097152
```

Sanjay: override applied to 3/5 hosts, continuing rollout.

OpsBot: SYSTEM: Deployment event - config override applied to hosts [kv-13, kv-14, kv-15].

Raj: good. hooking up a temporary throttle on prefetch concurrency too. reduces IO pressure.

Marta: pushing hotfix: reverting batch-optimizer to v2.3.0 on canary (2 hosts). if green we'll promote.

Marta: canary looks stable after 6 minutes. latency down ~40% on canary. promoting to full.

OpsBot: SYSTEM: rollback: batch-optimizer v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 initiated.

Sanjay: eviction rate dropping, paged-kv memory delta starting to flatten.

CS-Bot: Update: Acme ticket #7892 shows reduced timeouts after 11:45 UTC.

Jeff: note: we saw a metadata leak pattern in blockmgr where metadata refs weren't released quickly enough when prefetched blocks were evicted. we'll need an actual code fix, not just config.

Marta: created issue #PR-4521 for metadata leak + add GC pass in blockmgr. will include tests and a perf regression harness.

Raj: immediate customer-facing note: Ops->CS drafted an advisory to affected accounts summarizing mitigations and ETA for full fix.

Lina: pushing monitoring alerts: add guardrail on prefetched_block_count and max_metadata_entries so future spikes alert earlier.

Sanjay: summary so far: flipped flag to disable continuous_batching, rolled back batch-optimizer to v2.3.0, applied block_size override to 2MB for us-east paged-kv, added prefetch concurrency throttle. memory growth stabilized.

Marta: next: full code fix for metadata leak (PR soon), add unit/integ tests, and plan gradual reintroduction of optimized batching behind a canary with tighter prefetch budget.

Raj: handing off to night oncall: @Raj -> @Jeff. Jeff, you're primary for next 12h. Please monitor evictions, paged-kv memory, and customer tickets. escalate to SRE if metrics deviate.

Jeff: ack. I'll keep watch and post periodic updates. pls DM if anything urgent.

OpsBot: INCIDENT NOTE added to thread: mitigations applied, monitoring in place, customers notified, root cause suspected: prefetch + block_size interaction exposing metadata retention bug.

CS-Bot: Sent status update to affected accounts at 12:05 UTC.

Jeff: leaving final checklist: 1) Ensure nightly sweep tests for paged-kv GC run tomorrow 2) PR-4521 review priority 3) backfill missing traces for 11:10-11:30 window 4) update runbook with new flags/overrides.

Raj: thanks team. handing off pager. :thumbsup:

Jeff: signing on for overnight. will update channel if anything changes. :eyes:
